# Overview

Combined cross-cell-line LOY-vs-sgCTRL comparison across the three reprocessed
analyses (HT1080, A549, LNCaP) — same STAR_v2_PARfix re-quantification, same
downstream RMD template (LFC=0.75, paired DE, fgsea Hallmark + DoRothEA TF +
decoupleR ULM). Each per-cell-line report tells the within-line story; this
report asks the cross-line question: *where does LOY induce a shared
transcriptional response, and where does each line do its own thing?*

**Design constraint.** A549 has 0 DEGs at FDR<0.05 & |lfc|>0.75 — passage
variance dominates the LOY signal for that line. To keep A549 informative,
the report runs both a **strict significance** view (Venn / UpSet of
thresholded hits) and a **ranked-statistic** view (pairwise Spearman of
t-statistics + scatter of logFCs on the union of all genes).

**Counts pipeline.** All inputs come from STAR_v2_PARfix counts — the
PAR-Y-masked realignment that fixed the chrX-PAR drop-out in the original
STAR run. PAR genes are kept in the per-cell DE results (so they appear in
scatter/correlation views below); pathway-overlap inputs (Hallmark / DoRothEA
/ decoupleR) were already PAR-stripped at the per-cell rank-prep boundary
(see `prep_ranks_t()` in each base Rmd's §5).

| Cell line | Samples | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| HT1080 | 9 (3+3+3) | NRAS Q61K; clean PCA separation; strong DE signal |
| A549   | 11 (4+4+3) | KRAS G12S, p53-null, CDKN2A−/−; passage variance dominates → few DE hits at strict threshold |
| LNCaP  | 6 (3+3) | AR T878A, PTEN−/−; no PARENTAL arm |

Every figure is saved to `combined/figures/` as both PNG (review) and PDF
(publication). Overlap CSVs land under `combined/DE_overlap/`,
`combined/pathway_overlap/`, `combined/TF_overlap/`.

## 1.2 Paths, parameters, helpers

```{r define-paths}
DATA_ROOT     <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects"
# Per-cell-line outputs live under analysis/02_rnaseq/<CELL>/ — i.e. next to
# this Rmd. Use a relative root so the notebook is repo-portable.
ANALYSIS_ROOT <- getwd()
COUNTS_ROOT   <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "RNAseq", "counts", "STAR_v2_PARfix")

# Cell-line metadata. The new repo uses LNCaP (mixed case); per-cell file
# prefixes are: HT1080 -> ht1080_, A549 -> a549_, LNCaP -> ht1080_ (template
# carryover when LNCaP base was forked from the HT1080 base Rmd — the file
# CONTENTS are LNCaP, only the filenames inherit the ht1080_ prefix).
CELL_LINES   <- c("HT1080", "A549", "LNCaP")
CELL_PREFIX  <- c(HT1080 = "ht1080", A549 = "a549", LNCaP = "ht1080")
COUNTS_DIRS  <- c(
  HT1080 = file.path(COUNTS_ROOT, "AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY"),
  A549   = file.path(COUNTS_ROOT, "AUG_2025_A549_LOY"),
  LNCaP  = file.path(COUNTS_ROOT, "MAY_2026_LNCAP_LOY")
)

BASE_DIR    <- getwd()
COMBINED    <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "combined")
DE_OUT      <- file.path(COMBINED, "DE_overlap")
PATHWAY_OUT <- file.path(COMBINED, "pathway_overlap")
TF_OUT      <- file.path(COMBINED, "TF_overlap")
FIG_DIR     <- file.path(COMBINED, "figures")

for (d in c(DE_OUT, PATHWAY_OUT, TF_OUT, FIG_DIR)) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

ALPHA   <- 0.05
LFC_THR <- 0.75

cell_cols <- c(HT1080 = "#1B9E77",
               A549   = "#D95F02",
               LNCaP  = "#7570B3")
treat_shapes <- c(CTRL = 16, LOY = 17, PARENTAL = 15)

save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)  [%gx%g in]\n", name, width, height))
  invisible(plot)
}

# Helper: write a base-graphics object (UpSetR / VennDiagram grid::grob) to
# PNG + PDF. `expr` is a quoted plotting call.
save_base_fig <- function(expr, name, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  png(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
      width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi, bg = "white")
  eval(expr); dev.off()
  pdf(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
      width = width, height = height)
  eval(expr); dev.off()
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)  [%gx%g in]\n", name, width, height))
}
```

## 1.3 Per-cell input file helper

Different per-cell-line notebooks emit slightly different filenames; centralise
the lookup so the loaders stay one-liner.

```{r per-cell-file-helper}
per_cell_file <- function(cell, subdir, suffix) {
  pref <- CELL_PREFIX[[cell]]
  file.path(ANALYSIS_ROOT, cell, subdir,
            paste0(pref, "_", suffix))
}
```

# 2. Load per-cell-line outputs

## 2.1 DE results (paired)

```{r load-de}
load_de <- function(cell) {
  f <- per_cell_file(cell, "DE", "LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_paired.csv")
  fread(f, data.table = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(cell_line = cell)
}

de_long <- map_dfr(CELL_LINES, load_de) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_line, gene_id, gene_name, seqnames,
                logFC, t, PValue, FDR, logCPM)

cat("Per-cell-line DE rows:\n")
de_long %>% dplyr::count(cell_line) %>% knitr::kable()

# Wide tables keyed on gene_name (unique gene symbol intersection)
de_lfc_wide <- de_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, gene_name) %>%
  slice_max(abs(logFC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "gene_name",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "logFC")

de_t_wide <- de_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, gene_name) %>%
  slice_max(abs(t), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "gene_name",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "t")

de_fdr_wide <- de_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, gene_name) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "gene_name",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "FDR")

# Inner-join: only genes present in all three lines
de_shared <- de_lfc_wide %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  inner_join(de_t_wide   %>% drop_na() %>%
               rename_with(~ paste0("t_", .), -gene_name),
             by = "gene_name") %>%
  inner_join(de_fdr_wide %>% drop_na() %>%
               rename_with(~ paste0("fdr_", .), -gene_name),
             by = "gene_name")

cat(sprintf("\nGenes scored in all three lines: %d\n", nrow(de_shared)))
```

## 2.1.5 Y-region rows (chrY MSY, for the §5.3 Y-inclusive scatter)

The per-cell paired DE results loaded in §2.1 retain PAR genes but strip
chrY (MSY) — MSY would dominate the contrast and confuse any pathway-level
analyses. To get chrY rows for the cross-line scatter in §5.3, load the
`<cell>_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv` tables (written by §3.5 / §4.0 of each
per-cell Rmd) and keep just the MSY rows (PAR rows are already in
`de_long` via the paired DE).

```{r load-yregion}
# Per-cell yregion CSV filenames differ slightly because the LNCaP yregion
# was written with the lncap_ prefix while the rest of LNCaP's DE CSVs use
# the ht1080_ template-carryover prefix. Hardcode the path map.
yregion_files <- c(
  HT1080 = file.path(ANALYSIS_ROOT, "HT1080", "DE",
                     "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv"),
  A549   = file.path(ANALYSIS_ROOT, "A549",   "DE",
                     "a549_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv"),
  LNCaP  = file.path(ANALYSIS_ROOT, "LNCaP",  "DE",
                     "lncap_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv"))

de_yregion_full <- imap_dfr(yregion_files, function(f, cell) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    warning("yregion file missing for ", cell, ": ", f)
    return(NULL)
  }
  fread(f, data.table = FALSE) %>% mutate(cell_line = cell)
})

# Keep all 4 region levels; we'll filter to MSY in §5.3 (PAR rows already
# in de_long via the paired DE, but expose all here for completeness).
de_yregion_full %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_line, region) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Y-region rows per cell line × region")

# Wide table of MSY logFC + FDR per cell (used in §5.3 for the overlay)
de_msy_wide <- de_yregion_full %>%
  dplyr::filter(region %in% c("MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_line, gene_name, region, logFC, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("gene_name", "region"),
              names_from = "cell_line",
              values_from = c("logFC", "FDR"))

# 4-region palette matches the per-cell extended notebooks' §11.1 scheme
y_region_cols <- c(
  "PAR1"   = "#0072B2",
  "PAR2"   = "#56B4E9",
  "MSY-Yp" = "#D55E00",
  "MSY-Yq" = "#E69F00")
```

# 3. Combined PCA {.tabset}

## 3.1 Build combined DGEList

```{r combined-dge}
genes_db <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) %>% as.data.frame()

read_one_count_dir <- function(cell, dir_path) {
  fs <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  fs <- fs[!grepl("\\.summary$", fs)]
  dl <- lapply(fs, function(f) {
    d <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE, header = TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(1, 7)
    names(d) <- c("geneID", sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(f)))
    column_to_rownames(d, "geneID")
  })
  m <- do.call("cbind", dl)
  m[grepl("^ENSG", rownames(m)), ]
}

mats <- lapply(seq_along(CELL_LINES), function(i)
  read_one_count_dir(CELL_LINES[i], COUNTS_DIRS[[CELL_LINES[i]]]))
names(mats) <- CELL_LINES

# Strip Ensembl version suffix and intersect gene IDs across all 3 matrices
strip_ver <- function(v) gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", v)
for (i in seq_along(mats)) rownames(mats[[i]]) <- strip_ver(rownames(mats[[i]]))
common_ids <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mats, rownames))
cat("Common Ensembl IDs across cell lines:", length(common_ids), "\n")
mats <- lapply(mats, function(m) m[common_ids, , drop = FALSE])

count_matrix <- do.call(cbind, unname(mats))  # unname avoids list-name prefix
cat("Combined count matrix:", nrow(count_matrix), "x", ncol(count_matrix), "\n")

# Sample metadata table
parse_sample <- function(id) {
  cell <- ifelse(grepl("^HT1080-", id), "HT1080",
          ifelse(grepl("^A549-",   id), "A549",
          ifelse(grepl("^LNCaP-",  id), "LNCaP", NA_character_)))
  trt  <- ifelse(grepl("-LOY-",      id), "LOY",
          ifelse(grepl("-CTRL-",     id), "CTRL",
          ifelse(grepl("-sgCTRL-",   id), "CTRL",
          ifelse(grepl("-PARENTAL-", id), "PARENTAL", NA_character_))))
  rep  <- sub(".*-([^-]+)$", "\\1", id)
  data.frame(sample_id = id, cell_line = cell, treatment = trt,
             replicate = rep, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
samples_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(count_matrix), parse_sample))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(samples_combined$cell_line)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(samples_combined$treatment)))

samples_combined %>%
  group_by(cell_line, treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Combined sample count")

cell_line <- factor(samples_combined$cell_line, levels = CELL_LINES)
treatment <- factor(samples_combined$treatment,
                    levels = c("PARENTAL", "CTRL", "LOY"))

dge_all <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix,
                   group = paste(cell_line, treatment, sep = "_"))
dge_all$samples$cell_line <- cell_line
dge_all$samples$treatment <- treatment
dge_all$samples$replicate <- samples_combined$replicate

# Annotate with gene names + region (chrY MSY only — PAR sits on chrX in the
# Ensembl annotation, see per-cell-line §2.1.5 / §1.4.5 for the split policy)
match_idx <- match(common_ids, genes_db$gene_id)
dge_all$genes <- data.frame(
  gene_id   = common_ids,
  gene_name = genes_db$gene_name[match_idx],
  seqnames  = as.character(genes_db$seqnames[match_idx]),
  start     = genes_db$start[match_idx],
  end       = genes_db$end[match_idx],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Match per-cell-line policy: strip chrY (MSY) before PCA; PAR genes stay in
# the matrix so the chrX-PAR LOY signal contributes to the cross-line scatter.
chrY_ids <- dge_all$genes$gene_id[
  !is.na(dge_all$genes$seqnames) & dge_all$genes$seqnames == "Y"]
strip_idx <- which(rownames(dge_all) %in% chrY_ids)
if (length(strip_idx) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Stripping %d chrY (MSY) genes before PCA\n", length(strip_idx)))
  dge_all <- dge_all[-strip_idx, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
}

# Standard QC filter + TMM
keep <- filterByExpr(dge_all,
                     group = paste(cell_line, treatment, sep = "_"),
                     min.total.count = 200)
dge_all <- dge_all[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_all <- calcNormFactors(dge_all, method = "TMM")
lcpm    <- cpm(dge_all, log = TRUE)

cat("After filterByExpr + TMM:", nrow(dge_all), "genes,",
    ncol(dge_all), "samples\n")
```

## 3.2 PCA helpers

```{r pca-helpers}
compute_pca <- function(mat, ngenes = 2000, samples_df) {
  ngenes <- min(ngenes, nrow(mat))
  vg <- sort(apply(mat, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE)
  X  <- t(mat[names(vg)[1:ngenes], , drop = FALSE])
  pca <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  list(
    df = cbind(samples_df, as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3])),
    var_exp = (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  )
}

plot_pca <- function(pca_obj, x_pc, y_pc, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  xi <- as.integer(sub("PC", "", x_pc))
  yi <- as.integer(sub("PC", "", y_pc))
  ggplot(pca_obj$df, aes(.data[[x_pc]], .data[[y_pc]])) +
    geom_point(aes(color = cell_line, shape = treatment), size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 2.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_cols) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = treat_shapes) +
    labs(
      title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
      x = paste0(x_pc, " (", round(pca_obj$var_exp[xi] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0(y_pc, " (", round(pca_obj$var_exp[yi] * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}

samples_df <- dge_all$samples %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, cell_line, treatment, replicate)
```

## 3.3 Raw PCA — all samples {.tabset}

PC1 will almost certainly separate the three cell lines — this confirms the
cell-line variance is the dominant axis and motivates the batch-correction
in §3.4.

### PC1 vs PC2

```{r pca-raw-12, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
pca_raw <- compute_pca(lcpm, samples_df = samples_df)

p_raw_12 <- plot_pca(
  pca_raw, "PC1", "PC2",
  title = sprintf("Combined PCA — raw, all %d samples (top 2000 var genes)",
                  ncol(lcpm)),
  subtitle = "Color = cell line; shape = treatment")
print(p_raw_12)
save_fig(p_raw_12, "pca_raw_pc1_pc2", width = 8, height = 6)
```

### PC1 vs PC3

```{r pca-raw-13, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
p_raw_13 <- plot_pca(
  pca_raw, "PC1", "PC3",
  title = "Combined PCA — raw, PC1 vs PC3",
  subtitle = "Color = cell line; shape = treatment")
print(p_raw_13)
save_fig(p_raw_13, "pca_raw_pc1_pc3", width = 8, height = 6)
```

## 3.4 Batch-corrected PCA — `removeBatchEffect(batch=cell_line)` {.tabset}

`limma::removeBatchEffect` subtracts cell-line means while preserving the
treatment effect via `design = model.matrix(~ treatment)`. After correction
PC1/PC2 should reveal whether LOY samples cluster across cell lines (i.e. a
shared LOY transcriptional signature) or whether each line's LOY response
remains line-specific.

### PC1 vs PC2

```{r pca-corr-12, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
design_corr <- model.matrix(~ treatment, data = dge_all$samples)
lcpm_corr <- removeBatchEffect(lcpm,
                               batch  = dge_all$samples$cell_line,
                               design = design_corr)

pca_corr <- compute_pca(lcpm_corr, samples_df = samples_df)

p_corr_12 <- plot_pca(
  pca_corr, "PC1", "PC2",
  title = "Combined PCA — cell-line effect removed",
  subtitle = "removeBatchEffect(batch=cell_line); shape = treatment")
print(p_corr_12)
save_fig(p_corr_12, "pca_batchcorr_pc1_pc2", width = 8, height = 6)
```

### PC1 vs PC3

```{r pca-corr-13, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
p_corr_13 <- plot_pca(
  pca_corr, "PC1", "PC3",
  title = "Combined PCA — cell-line effect removed, PC1 vs PC3",
  subtitle = "removeBatchEffect(batch=cell_line); shape = treatment")
print(p_corr_13)
save_fig(p_corr_13, "pca_batchcorr_pc1_pc3", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r sample-distance, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
sample_dist <- as.matrix(dist(t(lcpm_corr)))
ann_col <- data.frame(

  Treatment = dge_all$samples$treatment,
  row.names = colnames(lcpm_corr)

}

save_base_fig(quote(dist_plot()), "sample_distance_batchcorr",
              width = 7, height = 6)
dist_plot()
```

# 4. DEG overlap — strict significance

## 4.1 Build per-cell-line up / down sets

```{r deg-sets}
deg_set <- function(df, dir = c("up", "down")) {
  dir <- match.arg(dir)
  if (dir == "up") {
    df %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC >  LFC_THR) %>% pull(gene_name) %>%
      na.omit() %>% unique()
  } else {
    df %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC < -LFC_THR) %>% pull(gene_name) %>%
      na.omit() %>% unique()
  }
}

up_sets <- lapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
  deg_set(de_long %>% dplyr::filter(cell_line == c), "up"))
dn_sets <- lapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
  deg_set(de_long %>% dplyr::filter(cell_line == c), "down"))
names(up_sets) <- CELL_LINES
names(dn_sets) <- CELL_LINES

cat("DEG set sizes (FDR<", ALPHA, " & |lfc|>", LFC_THR, "):\n", sep = "")
data.frame(
  cell_line = CELL_LINES,
  n_up   = sapply(up_sets, length),
  n_down = sapply(dn_sets, length)
) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## 4.2 3-way Venn — UP in LOY

```{r venn-up, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
draw_venn <- function(sets, fill_cols, name) {
  futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR,
                                name = "VennDiagramLogger")
  venn.diagram(
    x = sets, filename = NULL,
    category.names = names(sets),
    fill = fill_cols, alpha = 0.45,
    lwd = 1, col = "grey20",
    cat.col = fill_cols, cat.cex = 1.1, cat.fontfamily = "sans",
    cex = 1.1, fontfamily = "sans",
    main = name, main.cex = 1.2, main.fontfamily = "sans")
}

venn_up <- draw_venn(up_sets, unname(cell_cols),
                     "Up in LOY (FDR<0.05, lfc>0.75)")
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(venn_up)
save_base_fig(quote({grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(venn_up)}),
              "venn_up_in_LOY", width = 5, height = 5)
```

## 4.4 UpSet plots

```{r upset, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
make_upset_input <- function(sets) {
  all_genes <- unique(unlist(sets))
  if (length(all_genes) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.frame(sapply(sets, function(s) as.integer(all_genes %in% s)))
  rownames(df) <- all_genes
  df
}

upset_up <- make_upset_input(up_sets)
upset_dn <- make_upset_input(dn_sets)

if (!is.null(upset_up) && nrow(upset_up) > 0) {
  print(upset(upset_up, sets = CELL_LINES, order.by = "freq",
              main.bar.color = "#D55E00",
              sets.bar.color = unname(cell_cols),
              text.scale = 1.2,
              mainbar.y.label = "Up-in-LOY intersection size",
              sets.x.label = "Up-in-LOY set size"))
  save_base_fig(quote(print(upset(upset_up, sets = CELL_LINES,
                                  order.by = "freq",
                                  main.bar.color = "#D55E00",
                                  sets.bar.color = unname(cell_cols),
                                  text.scale = 1.2,
                                  mainbar.y.label =
                                    "Up-in-LOY intersection size",
                                  sets.x.label = "Up-in-LOY set size"))),
                "upset_up_in_LOY", width = 8, height = 6)
}

if (!is.null(upset_dn) && nrow(upset_dn) > 0) {
  print(upset(upset_dn, sets = CELL_LINES, order.by = "freq",
              main.bar.color = "#0072B2",
              sets.bar.color = unname(cell_cols),
              text.scale = 1.2,
              mainbar.y.label = "Down-in-LOY intersection size",
              sets.x.label = "Down-in-LOY set size"))
  save_base_fig(quote(print(upset(upset_dn, sets = CELL_LINES,
                                  order.by = "freq",
                                  main.bar.color = "#0072B2",
                                  sets.bar.color = unname(cell_cols),
                                  text.scale = 1.2,
                                  mainbar.y.label =
                                    "Down-in-LOY intersection size",
                                  sets.x.label = "Down-in-LOY set size"))),
                "upset_down_in_LOY", width = 8, height = 6)
}
```

```{r intersection-tables}
  pair <- intersect(dn_sets[[a]], dn_sets[[b]])
  cat(sprintf("  %s & %s : %d\n", CELL_LINES[a], CELL_LINES[b], length(pair)))
}

  imap_dfr(up_sets, ~ tibble(cell_line = .y, direction = "up", gene = .x)),
  imap_dfr(dn_sets, ~ tibble(cell_line = .y, direction = "down", gene = .x))
)

  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% c(shared_up, shared_dn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_line, gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_line, values_from = c(logFC, FDR))
if (nrow(shared_table) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(shared_table,
               caption = "Genes hit at strict significance in all 3 lines")
  fwrite(shared_table, file.path(DE_OUT, "strict_3way_intersection.csv"))
}
```

# 5. DEG overlap — ranked statistic concordance

## 5.1 Pairwise Spearman correlation (t-stats)

```{r spearman-tstats, fig.height=4, fig.width=4.5}
t_mat <- de_shared %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("t_")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ sub("^t_", "", .))

cor_mat <- cor(t_mat, method = "spearman")
cat("Pairwise Spearman correlation of t-statistics across cell lines",
    sprintf("(n=%d shared genes):\n", nrow(t_mat)))
print(round(cor_mat, 3))

cor_df <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_y") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell_y, names_to = "cell_x", values_to = "rho") %>%
  mutate(cell_x = factor(cell_x, levels = CELL_LINES),
         cell_y = factor(cell_y, levels = CELL_LINES))

p_cor <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(cell_x, cell_y, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)),
            color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey95", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Spearman corr. of paired-DE t-statistics",
       subtitle = sprintf("Across %d genes shared in all 3 lines",
                          nrow(t_mat)),
       x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = expression(rho)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_cor)
save_fig(p_cor, "spearman_corr_tstats", width = 4.5, height = 4)
```

## 5.2 Pairwise logFC scatter {.tabset}

One pair per tab so each panel renders at full readable size. Labels = top 30
genes by `|lfc_a| + |lfc_b|` among the genes significant in BOTH cell lines
(FDR<0.05 in each).

```{r logfc-scatter-helper}
make_pair_scatter <- function(cell_a, cell_b, n_label = 30,
                              fdr_thr = ALPHA) {
  df <- de_shared %>%
    transmute(
      gene_name,
      lfc_a = .data[[cell_a]],
      lfc_b = .data[[cell_b]],
      fdr_a = .data[[paste0("fdr_", cell_a)]],
      fdr_b = .data[[paste0("fdr_", cell_b)]],
      sig_both = fdr_a < fdr_thr & fdr_b < fdr_thr,
      concordance = case_when(
        sig_both & lfc_a > 0 & lfc_b > 0 ~ "Both up (concordant)",
        sig_both & lfc_a < 0 & lfc_b < 0 ~ "Both down (concordant)",
        sig_both                          ~ "Opposite (discordant)",
        TRUE                              ~ "NS in ≥ 1"
      ),
      concordance = factor(concordance,
        levels = c("Both up (concordant)", "Both down (concordant)",
                   "Opposite (discordant)", "NS in ≥ 1"))
    )
  rho_v <- cor(df$lfc_a, df$lfc_b, method = "spearman")
  rho_p <- cor(df$lfc_a, df$lfc_b, method = "pearson")
  to_label <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig_both) %>%
    mutate(score = abs(lfc_a) + abs(lfc_b)) %>%
    slice_max(score, n = n_label)

  cols_v <- c(
    "Both up (concordant)"   = "#D55E00",
    "Both down (concordant)" = "#0072B2",
    "Opposite (discordant)"  = "#999999",
    "NS in ≥ 1"          = "grey85"
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(lfc_a, lfc_b, color = concordance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., concordance == "NS in ≥ 1"),
               alpha = 0.25, size = 1.0) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., concordance != "NS in ≥ 1"),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 2.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = to_label, aes(label = gene_name),
                    size = 3.6, fontface = "italic", color = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.45,
                    force = 2, min.segment.length = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_v, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = paste("logFC", cell_a, "(LOY/sgCTRL)"),
      y = paste("logFC", cell_b, "(LOY/sgCTRL)"),
      title = paste(cell_a, "vs", cell_b),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Spearman rho = %.2f  |  Pearson r = %.2f  |  FDR < %s in both",
        rho_v, rho_p, format(fdr_thr, drop0trailing = TRUE)),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
}

pairs <- list(c("HT1080","A549"), c("HT1080","LNCaP"), c("A549","LNCaP"))
```

## 5.2b Pairwise logFC scatter — relaxed FDR thresholds {.tabset}

Same per-pair scatter as §5.2 but with the "significant in BOTH lines"
threshold relaxed step-wise. As FDR loosens, the **coloured** point cloud
grows (more genes call as concordant or discordant), and labels surface
moderate-effect concordant hits that miss strict §5.2's FDR<0.05 cutoff
— useful when one line (e.g. A549) has 0 hits at the strict threshold.

## 5.3 Pairwise logFC scatter — Y-region only {.tabset}

PAR + MSY genes only, no autosomal background. PAR rows come from the
per-cell paired DE (PAR is retained in `dge_lc`); MSY rows from the
`<cell>_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv` Y-retaining DE (see §2.1.5). Markers
coloured by region: PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY-Yp / MSY-Yq. Every gene labelled.

```{r logfc-scatter-yreg-helper}
make_pair_scatter_y <- function(cell_a, cell_b) {
  # PAR rows are in de_shared (paired DE retains PAR). Pull them by joining
  # against the PAR portion of de_yregion_full.
  par_genes_tbl <- de_yregion_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(region %in% c("PAR1", "PAR2")) %>%
    distinct(gene_name, region)
  par_layer <- de_shared %>%
    inner_join(par_genes_tbl, by = "gene_name") %>%
    transmute(gene_name, region,
              lfc_a = .data[[cell_a]],
              lfc_b = .data[[cell_b]])

  # MSY rows come from the Y-retaining DE (chrY is stripped from `dge_lc`,
  # so MSY isn't in de_shared)
  msy_layer <- de_msy_wide %>%
    transmute(gene_name, region,
              lfc_a = .data[[paste0("logFC_", cell_a)]],
              lfc_b = .data[[paste0("logFC_", cell_b)]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(lfc_a), !is.na(lfc_b))

  y_only <- bind_rows(par_layer, msy_layer) %>%
    mutate(region = factor(region,
                           levels = c("PAR1", "PAR2", "MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")))

  # Per-pair stats: computed on Y-region genes only
  rho_v <- cor(y_only$lfc_a, y_only$lfc_b,
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  rho_p <- cor(y_only$lfc_a, y_only$lfc_b,
               method = "pearson",  use = "complete.obs")

  ggplot(y_only, aes(lfc_a, lfc_b, fill = region)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(shape = 23, size = 4.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.6,
               alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene_name, color = region),
                    size = 3.8, fontface = "bold.italic",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey40",
                    segment.size = 0.4, box.padding = 0.5,
                    force = 3, min.segment.length = 0.1,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = y_region_cols, drop = FALSE,
                      name = "Y region") +
    scale_color_manual(values = y_region_cols, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x = paste("logFC", cell_a, "(LOY/sgCTRL)"),
      y = paste("logFC", cell_b, "(LOY/sgCTRL)"),
      title = paste(cell_a, "vs", cell_b, "— Y region (PAR + MSY)"),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Spearman rho = %.2f  |  Pearson r = %.2f  |  n = %d Y-region genes",
        rho_v, rho_p, nrow(y_only))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
}
```

## 5.4 Three-axis logFC scatter — all three cell lines simultaneously {.tabset}

Static 3D scatter where each axis is one cell line's logFC. A gene sitting
on or near the **x = y = z diagonal** is a concordant LOY responder (same
direction + magnitude in all three lines). Genes off the diagonal are
line-specific. Two viewing angles per panel; PNG/PDF saved to `figures/`.

(Switched from interactive plotly to static `scatterplot3d` because the
plotly bundle made the rendered HTML too large for some viewers.)

```{r 3d-scatter-helpers}
# Pull chromosome annotation once (de_long has seqnames per gene)
gene_chr <- de_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(seqnames)) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, seqnames) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% ungroup()

# PAR gene names (chrX-mapped) — from §2.1.5
par_gene_names_3d <- de_yregion_full %>%
  dplyr::filter(region %in% c("PAR1", "PAR2")) %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>% unique()

# Concordance classifier — sign-agreement at a given FDR cutoff
classify_concordance <- function(df, fdr_thr = ALPHA) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      sig_all3 = fdr_HT1080 < fdr_thr & fdr_A549 < fdr_thr &
                 fdr_LNCaP < fdr_thr,
      sig_any  = fdr_HT1080 < fdr_thr | fdr_A549 < fdr_thr |
                 fdr_LNCaP < fdr_thr,
      class = case_when(
        sig_all3 & HT1080 > 0 & A549 > 0 & LNCaP > 0 ~ "All up (concordant)",
        sig_all3 & HT1080 < 0 & A549 < 0 & LNCaP < 0 ~ "All down (concordant)",
        sig_all3                                      ~ "Discordant sign",
        sig_any                                       ~ "Sig in ≥1 line",
        TRUE                                          ~ "NS"
      ),
      class = factor(class,
        levels = c("All up (concordant)", "All down (concordant)",
                   "Discordant sign", "Sig in ≥1 line", "NS"))
    )
}

class_cols <- c(
  "All up (concordant)"   = "#D55E00",
  "All down (concordant)" = "#0072B2",
  "Discordant sign"       = "#999999",
  "Sig in ≥1 line"        = "#BBBBBB",
  "NS"                    = "grey85")

# scatterplot3d wrapper that draws two view angles in one chunk and saves
# both PNG + PDF. Returns nothing; called for side effect.
draw_3d_scatter <- function(df, color_col, color_palette, fig_name,
                            title, label_subset = NULL,
                            angles = c(20, 60), z_angle = 30,
                            pch_map = NULL, point_size = 1.5,
                            label_col = "gene_name",
                            axis_cols = c("HT1080", "A549", "LNCaP"),
                            axis_labs = c(
                              x = "logFC HT1080 (LOY/sgCTRL)",
                              y = "logFC A549 (LOY/sgCTRL)",
                              z = "logFC LNCaP (LOY/sgCTRL)"),
                            save_w = 8, save_h = 7) {
  pt_col <- color_palette[as.character(df[[color_col]])]
  pt_pch <- if (is.null(pch_map)) 19
            else pch_map[as.character(df[[color_col]])]
  xv <- df[[axis_cols[1]]]; yv <- df[[axis_cols[2]]]; zv <- df[[axis_cols[3]]]

  render_one <- function(angle, do_legend = FALSE) {
    s3 <- scatterplot3d(
      xv, yv, zv,
      color = pt_col, pch = pt_pch,
      cex.symbols = point_size, cex.axis = 0.9, cex.lab = 1.0,
      angle = angle,
      xlab = axis_labs["x"], ylab = axis_labs["y"], zlab = axis_labs["z"],
      main = sprintf("%s — view angle %d°", title, angle),
      box = TRUE, grid = TRUE)
    # Optional text labels for a subset of rows (genes / pathways / TFs)
    if (!is.null(label_subset)) {
      lab_idx <- df[[label_col]] %in% label_subset
      if (any(lab_idx)) {
        coords <- s3$xyz.convert(xv[lab_idx], yv[lab_idx], zv[lab_idx])
        text(coords$x, coords$y, labels = df[[label_col]][lab_idx],
             cex = 0.7, font = 3, pos = 3, offset = 0.3)
      }
    }
    if (do_legend) {
      legend("topleft",
             legend = names(color_palette),
             col    = color_palette,
             pch    = if (is.null(pch_map)) 19
                      else pch_map[names(color_palette)],
             pt.cex = 1.2, cex = 0.75, bty = "n",
             inset = c(-0.02, -0.02), xpd = TRUE)
    }
  }

  # Inline render: two-up via par(mfrow); legend on first panel
  op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(3, 3, 3, 1))
  render_one(angles[1], do_legend = TRUE)
  render_one(angles[2], do_legend = FALSE)
  par(op)

  # Save: PNG + PDF (two-up composite)
  save_two_up <- function(path, dev, ...) {
    dev(path, ...); op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(3, 3, 3, 1))
    render_one(angles[1], do_legend = TRUE)
    render_one(angles[2], do_legend = FALSE)
    par(op); dev.off()
  }
  save_two_up(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(fig_name, ".png")),
              png, width = save_w, height = save_h,
              units = "in", res = 200, bg = "white")
  save_two_up(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(fig_name, ".pdf")),
              pdf, width = save_w, height = save_h)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)\n", fig_name))
}
```

# 5.5 Pooled DESeq2 — cell line as covariate

Where the per-cell-line DE asks *"what changes inside this line when you
knock out Y?"*, the pooled DESeq2 model asks the cross-line question:
*"is there a shared LOY-vs-CTRL effect after absorbing cell-line baseline
differences?"* Design = `~ cell_line + treatment`; the `treatment` term is
the LOY effect adjusted for cell line. PARENTAL samples are dropped (LNCaP
doesn't have any; including them with `NA`-coded cell lines would unbalance
the design). Reference levels: `treatment = CTRL`, so `LOY` is the test
coefficient.

```{r deseq-pooled-fit, message=FALSE}
# Reuse the raw count_matrix + samples_combined built in §3.1 (pre-filter).
# Drop PARENTAL — pool the LOY-vs-CTRL contrast across cell lines.
pool_meta <- samples_combined %>%
  dplyr::filter(treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = CELL_LINES),
         treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY")))
pool_counts <- count_matrix[, pool_meta$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
cat(sprintf("Pooled DE input: %d genes × %d samples\n",
            nrow(pool_counts), ncol(pool_counts)))
print(table(cell_line = pool_meta$cell_line,
            treatment = pool_meta$treatment))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pool_counts,
  colData   = pool_meta,
  design    = ~ cell_line + treatment)

# Light pre-filter for speed (genes with ≥10 reads across all samples)
keep_dds <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep_dds, ]
cat(sprintf("After pre-filter (rowSum>=10): %d genes\n", nrow(dds)))

dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
cat("DESeq2 size factors:\n"); print(round(sizeFactors(dds), 3))
```

## 5.5.1 Pooled LOY-vs-CTRL results (cell_line covaried out)

```{r deseq-pooled-results}
res_pool <- results(dds,
                    contrast = c("treatment", "LOY", "CTRL"),
                    independentFiltering = TRUE,
                    alpha = ALPHA)
summary(res_pool)

# Annotate with gene name + chromosome (from §3.1 dge_all$genes is post-strip;
# rebuild from genes_db for the full universe)
gid <- rownames(res_pool)
match_idx <- match(gid, genes_db$gene_id)
res_pool_df <- as.data.frame(res_pool) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  mutate(gene_name = genes_db$gene_name[match_idx],
         seqnames  = as.character(genes_db$seqnames[match_idx]),
         start     = genes_db$start[match_idx],
         end       = genes_db$end[match_idx]) %>%
  arrange(padj)

# GRCh38 PAR coords (per per-cell extended notebooks §1.4.5). PAR genes
# annotate on chrX; chrY PAR positions are masked. Y_CENTROMERE_MID splits
# Yp/Yq.
PAR1_X_START <- 10001L;       PAR1_X_END   <- 2781479L
PAR2_X_START <- 155701383L;   PAR2_X_END   <- 156030895L
Y_CENTROMERE_MID <- 10430000L

classify_y_region <- function(seq, start_pos, end_pos) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    seq == "X" & start_pos >= PAR1_X_START & end_pos <= PAR1_X_END ~ "PAR1",
    seq == "X" & start_pos >= PAR2_X_START & end_pos <= PAR2_X_END ~ "PAR2",
    seq == "Y" & end_pos   <= Y_CENTROMERE_MID                     ~ "MSY-Yp",
    seq == "Y" & start_pos >= Y_CENTROMERE_MID                     ~ "MSY-Yq",
    TRUE                                                            ~ NA_character_)
}

res_pool_df <- res_pool_df %>%
  mutate(y_region = classify_y_region(seqnames, start, end),
         locus    = dplyr::coalesce(y_region, paste0("chr", seqnames)))

# Strict significance counts (matches per-cell thresholds)
n_up_strict <- sum(res_pool_df$padj < ALPHA &
                   res_pool_df$log2FoldChange >  LFC_THR, na.rm = TRUE)
n_dn_strict <- sum(res_pool_df$padj < ALPHA &
                   res_pool_df$log2FoldChange < -LFC_THR, na.rm = TRUE)
n_up_padj   <- sum(res_pool_df$padj < ALPHA &
                   res_pool_df$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_dn_padj   <- sum(res_pool_df$padj < ALPHA &
                   res_pool_df$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Pooled DESeq2 hits:\n  padj<%g only:           %d up / %d down\n  padj<%g & |LFC|>%.2f:    %d up / %d down\n",
            ALPHA, n_up_padj, n_dn_padj,
            ALPHA, LFC_THR, n_up_strict, n_dn_strict))

POOLED_OUT <- file.path(COMBINED, "DE_pooled")
dir.create(POOLED_OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
fwrite(res_pool_df, file.path(POOLED_OUT, "deseq2_pooled_LOY_v_CTRL.csv"))
saveRDS(dds, file.path(POOLED_OUT, "deseq2_dds.rds"))

# Top-20 most significant hits
knitr::kable(
  res_pool_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, locus, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj),
  digits = c(NA, NA, 3, 3, 2, 3, 3),
  caption = "Top 20 pooled DESeq2 hits (LOY vs CTRL, cell line covaried)")
```

## 5.5.2 Pooled volcano

```{r deseq-pooled-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
vp <- res_pool_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      padj < ALPHA & log2FoldChange >  LFC_THR ~ "Up (strict)",
      padj < ALPHA & log2FoldChange < -LFC_THR ~ "Down (strict)",
      padj < ALPHA                                 ~ "Sig (padj only)",
      TRUE                                         ~ "NS"),
    sig = factor(sig,
      levels = c("Up (strict)", "Down (strict)",
                 "Sig (padj only)", "NS")))

vol_cols <- c("Up (strict)"     = "#D55E00",
              "Down (strict)"   = "#0072B2",
              "Sig (padj only)" = "#999999",
              "NS"              = "grey85")

lab_up   <- vp %>% dplyr::filter(sig == "Up (strict)")     # label ALL up
lab_down <- vp %>% dplyr::filter(sig == "Down (strict)") %>%
              arrange(padj) %>% head(30)
top_lab  <- dplyr::bind_rows(lab_up, lab_down)

p_vol <- ggplot(vp, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LFC_THR, LFC_THR),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(ALPHA),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_lab, aes(label = gene_name),
                  size = 3.2, fontface = "italic",
                  max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.3,
                  box.padding = 0.4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = vol_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Pooled DESeq2 — LOY vs CTRL (cell line as covariate)",
       subtitle = sprintf(
         "%d genes tested; %d up / %d down @ padj<%g & |LFC|>%.2f",
         nrow(vp), n_up_strict, n_dn_strict, ALPHA, LFC_THR),
       x = "log2 FoldChange (LOY / CTRL, pooled)",
       y = "-log10(padj)", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_vol)
save_fig(p_vol, "deseq2_pooled_volcano", width = 7, height = 6)
```

### Strict-hit table (padj < `r ALPHA` & |LFC| > `r LFC_THR`)

Every gene called by the pooled model at the strict threshold, with its
locus annotated. `locus` is set to `PAR1`/`PAR2`/`MSY-Yp`/`MSY-Yq` for
Y-region genes, and `chr<N>` otherwise. Sorted by direction then by padj.

```{r deseq-pooled-strict-table}
strict_hits <- res_pool_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj),
                padj < ALPHA,
                abs(log2FoldChange) > LFC_THR) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  arrange(direction, padj) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, gene_id, locus, direction,
                log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj)

cat(sprintf("Strict hits at padj<%g & |LFC|>%.2f: %d up / %d down\n",
            ALPHA, LFC_THR,
            sum(strict_hits$direction == "Up"),
            sum(strict_hits$direction == "Down")))

# Locus-class summary (chrX / chrY / PAR / autosome breakdown)
locus_summary <- strict_hits %>%
  mutate(locus_class = dplyr::case_when(
           locus %in% c("PAR1", "PAR2")             ~ "PAR (chrX-mapped)",
           locus %in% c("MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")         ~ "MSY (chrY)",
           locus == "chrX"                           ~ "chrX (non-PAR)",
           grepl("^chr[0-9]+$", locus)               ~ "Autosome",
           TRUE                                       ~ "Other / scaffold")) %>%
  dplyr::count(direction, locus_class, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L)
knitr::kable(locus_summary,
             caption = "Strict pooled-DEG locus breakdown")

knitr::kable(strict_hits,
             digits = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 3, 3, 2, 3, 3),
             caption = sprintf(
               "Pooled DESeq2 strict hits — %d up / %d down (padj<%g & |LFC|>%.2f)",
               sum(strict_hits$direction == "Up"),
               sum(strict_hits$direction == "Down"),
               ALPHA, LFC_THR))

fwrite(strict_hits,
       file.path(POOLED_OUT, "deseq2_pooled_strict_hits.csv"))
```

## 5.5.3 Pooled vs per-cell concordance

For each per-cell DEG set (FDR<`r ALPHA` & |LFC|>`r LFC_THR`), ask:
how many are also called by the pooled DESeq2 model? The pooled model
typically picks up genes that move in the same direction in multiple
lines — line-specific hits won't survive once cell line is covaried out.

```{r deseq-pooled-vs-percell}
pool_sig <- res_pool_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < ALPHA, abs(log2FoldChange) > LFC_THR,
                !is.na(gene_name))
pool_up <- pool_sig$gene_name[pool_sig$log2FoldChange > 0]
pool_dn <- pool_sig$gene_name[pool_sig$log2FoldChange < 0]

concordance_tbl <- tibble(
  cell_line = CELL_LINES,
  percell_up         = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c) length(up_sets[[c]])),
  percell_dn         = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c) length(dn_sets[[c]])),
  pool_up_overlap    = sapply(CELL_LINES,
                              function(c) length(intersect(up_sets[[c]], pool_up))),
  pool_dn_overlap    = sapply(CELL_LINES,
                              function(c) length(intersect(dn_sets[[c]], pool_dn))),
  pool_up_pct        = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c) {
                              n <- length(up_sets[[c]])
                              if (n == 0) NA_real_
                              else 100 * length(intersect(up_sets[[c]], pool_up)) / n
                            }),
  pool_dn_pct        = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c) {
                              n <- length(dn_sets[[c]])
                              if (n == 0) NA_real_
                              else 100 * length(intersect(dn_sets[[c]], pool_dn)) / n
                            })
)
knitr::kable(concordance_tbl,
             digits = c(NA, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1),
             caption = sprintf(
               "Per-cell DEGs recovered by pooled DESeq2 (n_pooled: %d up / %d down)",
               length(pool_up), length(pool_dn)))
fwrite(concordance_tbl,
       file.path(POOLED_OUT, "pool_vs_percell_concordance.csv"))
```

## 6.2 Hallmark NES heatmap

```{r hallmark-heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=6}
mat <- hall_nes %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% as.matrix()
mat <- mat[, CELL_LINES]
padj_mat <- hall_padj %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% as.matrix()
padj_mat <- padj_mat[, CELL_LINES]

ord <- order(rowMeans(mat), decreasing = TRUE)
mat <- mat[ord, ]; padj_mat <- padj_mat[ord, ]

sig_mat <- ifelse(is.na(padj_mat), "",
           ifelse(padj_mat < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(padj_mat < 0.01,  "**",
           ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05,  "*", ""))))

clean_rownames <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  stringr::str_to_title(x)
}
rownames(mat)      <- clean_rownames(rownames(mat))
rownames(sig_mat)  <- rownames(mat)

hall_hm <- function() {
  pheatmap(mat,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks = seq(-max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 101),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = sig_mat, number_color = "black",
    fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 10,
    main = "Hallmark NES across cell lines\n(padj: * <0.05, ** <0.01, *** <0.001)")
}
save_base_fig(quote(hall_hm()), "hallmark_nes_heatmap",
              width = 6, height = 10)
hall_hm()
```

## 6.4 Pairwise NES scatter — Hallmark {.tabset}

One pair per tab so each scatter renders at full size with readable pathway
labels. Labels = top 15 pathways by `|NES_a| + |NES_b|`.

```{r hallmark-scatter-helper}
# Generalised pathway-NES scatter. Works on any (nes_wide, padj_wide) pair
# produced by §6.1 / §6.5 wide-matrix helpers — Hallmark, Reactome, KEGG,
# GO:BP — by passing the two data frames and a collection label.
clean_pathway_label <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME|KEGG_LEGACY|KEGG|GOBP|GO)_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  stringr::str_to_title(x)
}

make_path_scatter <- function(cell_a, cell_b, nes_df, padj_df,
                              coll_label = "Hallmark",
                              lab_top = 15) {
  df <- nes_df %>%
    transmute(pathway,
              nes_a = .data[[cell_a]],
              nes_b = .data[[cell_b]])
  df$padj_a <- padj_df[[cell_a]][match(df$pathway, padj_df$pathway)]
  df$padj_b <- padj_df[[cell_b]][match(df$pathway, padj_df$pathway)]
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    sig_both = padj_a < ALPHA & padj_b < ALPHA,
    concordance = case_when(
      sig_both & nes_a > 0 & nes_b > 0 ~ "Both up",
      sig_both & nes_a < 0 & nes_b < 0 ~ "Both down",
      sig_both                          ~ "Opposite",
      TRUE                              ~ "NS"
    ),
    concordance = factor(concordance,
      levels = c("Both up", "Both down", "Opposite", "NS"))
  )
  to_label <- df %>%
    mutate(extreme = abs(nes_a) + abs(nes_b)) %>%
    slice_max(extreme, n = lab_top) %>%
    mutate(short = clean_pathway_label(pathway))
  rho <- cor(df$nes_a, df$nes_b, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

  cols_v <- c("Both up" = "#D55E00", "Both down" = "#0072B2",
              "Opposite" = "#999999", "NS" = "grey85")

  ggplot(df, aes(nes_a, nes_b, color = concordance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
               linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
               linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., concordance == "NS"),
               alpha = 0.30, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., concordance != "NS"),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 3.0) +
    geom_text_repel(data = to_label, aes(label = short),
                    size = 3.4, color = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.45,
                    force = 2, min.segment.length = 0.2,
                    fontface = "italic") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_v, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = paste("NES", cell_a),
         y = paste("NES", cell_b),
         title = sprintf("%s NES: %s vs %s", coll_label, cell_a, cell_b),
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f  |  n = %d pathways",
                            rho, sum(complete.cases(df[, c("nes_a","nes_b")]))),
         color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
}
```

## 6.5 Pairwise NES scatter — Reactome / KEGG / GO:BP {.tabset}

Same pairwise structure as §6.4, but on the larger MSigDB collections. Top-N
labels per panel are scaled to the collection size (Reactome ~1600 sets,
KEGG ~190, GO:BP ~7500), so the most-extreme pathways stand out without
saturating the figure.

```{r path-scatter-other-helper}
# Build per-collection wide NES / padj matrices on the fly (mirrors §6.1).
build_path_mats <- function(coll_name) {
  sub <- gsea_full %>% dplyr::filter(collection == coll_name)
  nes_w  <- sub %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "pathway",
                                names_from = "cell_line",
                                values_from = "NES")
  padj_w <- sub %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "pathway",
                                names_from = "cell_line",
                                values_from = "padj")
  keep <- nes_w %>% drop_na() %>% pull(pathway)
  list(nes  = nes_w  %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% keep),
       padj = padj_w %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% keep),
       n_pathways = length(keep))
}

# Saved matrices for downstream re-use (and to log how many pathways survive
# the all-3-lines-tested filter per collection)
collections_other <- c(reactome = "reactome",
                       kegg     = "kegg",
                       go_bp    = "go_bp")
coll_labels <- c(reactome = "Reactome",
                 kegg     = "KEGG",
                 go_bp    = "GO:BP")
coll_mats <- lapply(collections_other, build_path_mats)
names(coll_mats) <- names(collections_other)

cat("Pathways scored in all 3 lines per collection:\n")
for (cn in names(coll_mats)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-9s %d\n", coll_labels[[cn]], coll_mats[[cn]]$n_pathways))
}

# Tune label count by collection size — bigger collection -> more labels.
# Hallmark uses 15; mirror that for the smaller collections and bump for
# Reactome / GO:BP.
lab_top_for <- function(cn) {
  switch(cn, kegg = 15, reactome = 20, go_bp = 25, 15)
}
```

## 6.6 Three-axis NES scatter — pathway collections {.tabset}

Each tab: one collection (Hallmark / Reactome / KEGG / GO:BP). Axes =
HT1080 / A549 / LNCaP NES. Pathways near the **x = y = z diagonal** are
concordant LOY responses across all three cell lines; off-diagonal
pathways are line-specific. Sign-concordance class is computed at
`padj < ALPHA` (`r ALPHA`) in **all three lines**. Top concordant pathways
(by `|NES_HT1080| + |NES_A549| + |NES_LNCaP|`) are labelled — label count
scales with collection size.

```{r path-3d-helper}
# Build a long-form 'NES + padj per cell line' table for any collection,
# pivot to wide, classify concordance, and return both the input matrix
# and the labels for the 3D scatter.
build_path_3d_df <- function(nes_wide, padj_wide,
                              fdr_thr = ALPHA,
                              lab_top = 15) {
  nes_w  <- nes_wide  %>% dplyr::filter(if_all(all_of(CELL_LINES), ~ !is.na(.)))
  padj_w <- padj_wide %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% nes_w$pathway)

  df <- nes_w %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, all_of(CELL_LINES)) %>%
    left_join(
      padj_w %>% dplyr::rename(padj_HT1080 = HT1080,
                                padj_A549   = A549,
                                padj_LNCaP  = LNCaP),
      by = "pathway") %>%
    mutate(
      sig_all3 = padj_HT1080 < fdr_thr & padj_A549 < fdr_thr &
                 padj_LNCaP  < fdr_thr,
      sig_any  = padj_HT1080 < fdr_thr | padj_A549 < fdr_thr |
                 padj_LNCaP  < fdr_thr,
      class = case_when(
        sig_all3 & HT1080 > 0 & A549 > 0 & LNCaP > 0 ~ "All up (concordant)",
        sig_all3 & HT1080 < 0 & A549 < 0 & LNCaP < 0 ~ "All down (concordant)",
        sig_all3                                      ~ "Discordant sign",
        sig_any                                       ~ "Sig in ≥1 line",
        TRUE                                          ~ "NS"),
      class = factor(class,
        levels = c("All up (concordant)", "All down (concordant)",
                   "Discordant sign", "Sig in ≥1 line", "NS")))

  to_label <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(class %in% c("All up (concordant)",
                                "All down (concordant)")) %>%
    mutate(extreme = abs(HT1080) + abs(A549) + abs(LNCaP)) %>%
    slice_max(extreme, n = lab_top) %>%
    pull(pathway)

  list(df = df, to_label = to_label)
}

path_class_cols <- c(
  "All up (concordant)"   = "#D55E00",
  "All down (concordant)" = "#0072B2",
  "Discordant sign"       = "#999999",
  "Sig in ≥1 line"        = "#BBBBBB",
  "NS"                    = "grey85")

# Per-collection label dictionary for plotting (keep short)
path_label_for_plot <- function(df, to_label) {
  df %>% mutate(label = clean_pathway_label(pathway)) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(pathway %in% to_label, label, ""))
}
```

# 7. TF overlap — DoRothEA

## 7.1 Wide NES matrix

```{r tf-wide}
tf_nes_wide <- tf_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "pathway",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "NES")
tf_padj_wide <- tf_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "pathway",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "padj")

keep_tfs <- tf_nes_wide %>% drop_na() %>% pull(pathway)
tf_nes  <- tf_nes_wide  %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% keep_tfs)
tf_padj <- tf_padj_wide %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% keep_tfs)
cat(sprintf("DoRothEA TFs scored in all 3 lines: %d\n", length(keep_tfs)))

fwrite(tf_nes,  file.path(TF_OUT, "dorothea_nes_matrix.csv"))
fwrite(tf_padj, file.path(TF_OUT, "dorothea_padj_matrix.csv"))

tf_sig_summary <- tf_long %>%
  group_by(cell_line) %>%
  summarise(n_act = sum(padj < ALPHA & NES > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_rep = sum(padj < ALPHA & NES < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(tf_sig_summary,
             caption = "Significant DoRothEA TFs per line (padj<0.05)")
```

## 7.2 3-way Venn — significant TFs

```{r venn-tf, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
sig_tfs <- lapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
  tf_long %>% dplyr::filter(cell_line == c, padj < ALPHA) %>% pull(pathway))
names(sig_tfs) <- CELL_LINES

venn_tfs <- draw_venn(sig_tfs, unname(cell_cols),
                      "Sig. DoRothEA TFs (padj<0.05)")
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(venn_tfs)
save_base_fig(quote({grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(venn_tfs)}),
              "venn_dorothea_sig", width = 5, height = 5)

shared_tfs <- Reduce(intersect, sig_tfs)
cat(sprintf("\nDoRothEA TFs significant in all 3 lines: %d\n",
            length(shared_tfs)))
if (length(shared_tfs) > 0) {
  shared_tf_df <- tf_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(pathway %in% shared_tfs) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_line, pathway, NES) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cell_line, values_from = NES)
  knitr::kable(shared_tf_df,
               caption = "NES of TFs significant in all 3 lines")
  fwrite(shared_tf_df, file.path(TF_OUT, "dorothea_3way_intersection.csv"))
}
```

## 7.3 DoRothEA NES heatmap (top 30 by mean |NES|)

```{r tf-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=5.5}
tf_mat  <- tf_nes  %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% as.matrix()
tf_pmat <- tf_padj %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% as.matrix()
tf_mat  <- tf_mat[, CELL_LINES]
tf_pmat <- tf_pmat[, CELL_LINES]

mean_abs_nes <- rowMeans(abs(tf_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
top_idx <- order(mean_abs_nes, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(30, nrow(tf_mat)))]
tf_mat_top <- tf_mat[top_idx, , drop = FALSE]
tf_pmat_top <- tf_pmat[top_idx, , drop = FALSE]
tf_mat_top  <- tf_mat_top[order(rowMeans(tf_mat_top), decreasing = TRUE), ]
tf_pmat_top <- tf_pmat_top[rownames(tf_mat_top), ]

sig_top <- ifelse(is.na(tf_pmat_top), "",
           ifelse(tf_pmat_top < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(tf_pmat_top < 0.01,  "**",
           ifelse(tf_pmat_top < 0.05,  "*", ""))))

tf_hm <- function() {
  pheatmap(tf_mat_top,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks = seq(-max(abs(tf_mat_top), na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(abs(tf_mat_top), na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 101),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = sig_top, number_color = "black",
    fontsize_row = 8, fontsize_col = 10,
    main = "DoRothEA TF activity NES (top 30 by mean |NES|)")
}
save_base_fig(quote(tf_hm()), "dorothea_nes_heatmap",
              width = 5.5, height = 8)
tf_hm()
```

## 7.4 Pairwise NES scatter (DoRothEA)

```{r tf-scatter, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=14}
make_tf_scatter <- function(cell_a, cell_b, lab_top = 10) {
  df <- tf_nes %>%
    transmute(pathway,
              nes_a = .data[[cell_a]],
              nes_b = .data[[cell_b]])
  df$padj_a <- tf_padj[[cell_a]][match(df$pathway, tf_padj$pathway)]
  df$padj_b <- tf_padj[[cell_b]][match(df$pathway, tf_padj$pathway)]
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    sig_both = padj_a < ALPHA & padj_b < ALPHA,
    concordance = case_when(
      sig_both & nes_a > 0 & nes_b > 0 ~ "Both activated",
      sig_both & nes_a < 0 & nes_b < 0 ~ "Both repressed",
      sig_both                          ~ "Opposite",
      TRUE                              ~ "NS"
    ),
    concordance = factor(concordance,
      levels = c("Both activated", "Both repressed", "Opposite", "NS"))
  )
  to_label <- df %>%
    mutate(extreme = abs(nes_a) + abs(nes_b)) %>%
    slice_max(extreme, n = lab_top)
  rho <- cor(df$nes_a, df$nes_b, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

  cols_v <- c("Both activated" = "#D55E00",
              "Both repressed" = "#0072B2",
              "Opposite" = "#999999",
              "NS" = "grey85")

  ggplot(df, aes(nes_a, nes_b, color = concordance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text_repel(data = to_label, aes(label = pathway),
                    size = 2.7, fontface = "bold.italic", color = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
                    box.padding = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_v, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = paste("NES", cell_a),
         y = paste("NES", cell_b),
         title = paste("DoRothEA TF NES:", cell_a, "vs", cell_b),
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f", rho),
         color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

tf_scatters <- lapply(pairs, function(p) make_tf_scatter(p[1], p[2]))
p_tf_scat <- wrap_plots(tf_scatters, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_tf_scat)
save_fig(p_tf_scat, "dorothea_nes_scatter_pairwise",
         width = 14, height = 5.5)
```

# 8. TF overlap — decoupleR (parallel check)

## 8.1 Wide score matrix

```{r dc-wide}
dc_score_wide <- dc_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "score")
dc_p_wide <- dc_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source",
              names_from = "cell_line", values_from = "p_value")
keep_dc <- dc_score_wide %>% drop_na() %>% pull(source)
dc_score <- dc_score_wide %>% dplyr::filter(source %in% keep_dc)
dc_p     <- dc_p_wide     %>% dplyr::filter(source %in% keep_dc)
cat(sprintf("decoupleR TFs scored in all 3 lines: %d\n", length(keep_dc)))
fwrite(dc_score, file.path(TF_OUT, "decoupleR_score_matrix.csv"))
fwrite(dc_p,     file.path(TF_OUT, "decoupleR_pvalue_matrix.csv"))
```

## 8.2 decoupleR score heatmap (top 30 by mean |score|)

```{r dc-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=5.5}
dc_mat  <- dc_score %>% column_to_rownames("source") %>% as.matrix()
dc_pmat <- dc_p     %>% column_to_rownames("source") %>% as.matrix()
dc_mat  <- dc_mat[, CELL_LINES]
dc_pmat <- dc_pmat[, CELL_LINES]

mean_abs_dc <- rowMeans(abs(dc_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
top_dc <- order(mean_abs_dc, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(30, nrow(dc_mat)))]
dc_mat_top <- dc_mat[top_dc, , drop = FALSE]
dc_pmat_top <- dc_pmat[top_dc, , drop = FALSE]
dc_mat_top  <- dc_mat_top[order(rowMeans(dc_mat_top), decreasing = TRUE), ]
dc_pmat_top <- dc_pmat_top[rownames(dc_mat_top), ]

sig_dc_top <- ifelse(is.na(dc_pmat_top), "",
              ifelse(dc_pmat_top < 0.001, "***",
              ifelse(dc_pmat_top < 0.01,  "**",
              ifelse(dc_pmat_top < 0.05,  "*", ""))))

dc_hm <- function() {
  pheatmap(dc_mat_top,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks = seq(-max(abs(dc_mat_top), na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(abs(dc_mat_top), na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 101),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = sig_dc_top, number_color = "black",
    fontsize_row = 8, fontsize_col = 10,
    main = "decoupleR ULM TF score (top 30 by mean |score|)")
}
save_base_fig(quote(dc_hm()), "decoupleR_score_heatmap",
              width = 5.5, height = 8)
dc_hm()
```

## 8.3 DoRothEA-vs-decoupleR concordance (per cell line)

```{r dc-vs-dorothea, fig.height=5, fig.width=14}
make_method_scatter <- function(cell) {
  d_tf <- tf_long %>% dplyr::filter(cell_line == cell) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES_dorothea = NES)
  d_dc <- dc_long %>% dplyr::filter(cell_line == cell) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway = source, score_decoupleR = score,
           p_decoupleR = p_value)
  m <- inner_join(d_tf, d_dc, by = "pathway")
  rho <- cor(m$NES_dorothea, m$score_decoupleR, method = "spearman")
  to_label <- m %>%
    mutate(extreme = abs(NES_dorothea) + abs(score_decoupleR)) %>%
    slice_max(extreme, n = 10)
  ggplot(m, aes(NES_dorothea, score_decoupleR)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6, color = cell_cols[[cell]]) +
    geom_text_repel(data = to_label, aes(label = pathway),
                    size = 2.6, fontface = "bold.italic",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, color = "black",
                    box.padding = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste(cell, "— DoRothEA vs decoupleR"),
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f  |  n = %d TFs", rho,
                            nrow(m)),
         x = "DoRothEA NES (MoR-weighted fgsea)",
         y = "decoupleR score (ULM)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

method_plots <- lapply(CELL_LINES, make_method_scatter)
p_methods <- wrap_plots(method_plots, ncol = 3)
print(p_methods)
save_fig(p_methods, "dorothea_vs_decoupleR_per_cell",
         width = 14, height = 5)
```

## 8.4 Three-axis decoupleR score scatter

Axes = HT1080 / A549 / LNCaP decoupleR ULM score. TFs near the diagonal are
LOY-concordant master regulators across all three lines. Sign-concordance
class computed at `p_value < ALPHA` (`r ALPHA`) in **all three lines**;
NS background drawn light. Top concordant TFs (by `sum(|score|)`) labelled.

```{r dc-3d, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
dc_3d <- dc_score %>%
  dplyr::filter(if_all(all_of(CELL_LINES), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  left_join(
    dc_p %>% dplyr::rename(p_HT1080 = HT1080,
                            p_A549   = A549,
                            p_LNCaP  = LNCaP),
    by = "source") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_all3 = p_HT1080 < ALPHA & p_A549 < ALPHA & p_LNCaP < ALPHA,
    sig_any  = p_HT1080 < ALPHA | p_A549 < ALPHA | p_LNCaP < ALPHA,
    class = case_when(
      sig_all3 & HT1080 > 0 & A549 > 0 & LNCaP > 0 ~ "All up (concordant)",
      sig_all3 & HT1080 < 0 & A549 < 0 & LNCaP < 0 ~ "All down (concordant)",
      sig_all3                                      ~ "Discordant sign",
      sig_any                                       ~ "Sig in ≥1 line",
      TRUE                                          ~ "NS"),
    class = factor(class,
      levels = c("All up (concordant)", "All down (concordant)",
                 "Discordant sign", "Sig in ≥1 line", "NS")))

cat(sprintf("decoupleR: %d TFs; concordant sig (all 3 lines): %d up / %d down\n",
            nrow(dc_3d),
            sum(dc_3d$class == "All up (concordant)"),
            sum(dc_3d$class == "All down (concordant)")))

dc_label_n <- 20
dc_to_label <- dc_3d %>%
  dplyr::filter(class %in% c("All up (concordant)",
                              "All down (concordant)")) %>%
  mutate(extreme = abs(HT1080) + abs(A549) + abs(LNCaP)) %>%
  slice_max(extreme, n = dc_label_n) %>%
  pull(source)

# Fall back to top |score| across any sig-≥1-line class if no all-3-concordant
if (length(dc_to_label) == 0) {
  dc_to_label <- dc_3d %>%
    dplyr::filter(class != "NS") %>%
    mutate(extreme = abs(HT1080) + abs(A549) + abs(LNCaP)) %>%
    slice_max(extreme, n = dc_label_n) %>%
    pull(source)
}

draw_3d_scatter(
  dc_3d %>% arrange(class),
  color_col = "class",
  color_palette = path_class_cols,
  fig_name = "3D_decoupleR_score",
  title = "decoupleR TF score — 3 cell lines",
  label_subset = dc_to_label,
  label_col = "source",
  axis_labs = c(x = "decoupleR score (HT1080)",
                y = "decoupleR score (A549)",
                z = "decoupleR score (LNCaP)"))
```

# 9. Summary table + 3-way concordant calls

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  cell_line = CELL_LINES,
  n_DEG_up   = sapply(up_sets, length),
  n_DEG_down = sapply(dn_sets, length),
  n_Hallmark_sig_up   = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
    sum(gsea_long$cell_line == c & gsea_long$padj < ALPHA &
        gsea_long$NES > 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_Hallmark_sig_down = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
    sum(gsea_long$cell_line == c & gsea_long$padj < ALPHA &
        gsea_long$NES < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_DoRothEA_sig_act = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
    sum(tf_long$cell_line == c & tf_long$padj < ALPHA &
        tf_long$NES > 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_DoRothEA_sig_rep = sapply(CELL_LINES, function(c)
    sum(tf_long$cell_line == c & tf_long$padj < ALPHA &
        tf_long$NES < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(summary_df, caption = "Per-cell-line summary")

cat("\n3-way concordant Hallmark pathways (NES sign agrees in all 3):\n")
hall_concordant <- hall_nes %>%
  dplyr::filter(sign(HT1080) == sign(A549) & sign(A549) == sign(LNCaP)) %>%
  mutate(mean_NES = (HT1080 + A549 + LNCaP) / 3) %>%

       file.path(PATHWAY_OUT, "hallmark_3way_concordant.csv"))

  dplyr::filter(sign(HT1080) == sign(A549) & sign(A549) == sign(LNCaP)) %>%
  mutate(mean_NES = (HT1080 + A549 + LNCaP) / 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(mean_NES)))
print(head(tf_concordant, 10), row.names = FALSE)
fwrite(tf_concordant, file.path(TF_OUT, "dorothea_3way_concordant.csv"))
```
